title: Supervised mobile verification for fixed-camera blind spots
user_role: Remote pet owners whose current cameras leave important blind spots
scene: An alert or prolonged absence creates a need to check another room
task: Inspect the relevant space before deciding whether intervention is needed
current_substitute: Fixed cameras or asking a neighbor
friction: Blind spots, additional installation, or a slow and socially costly neighbor request
acceptance_conditions: Physical shutter, room boundaries, explicit session start, and visible recording state
gaps: Privacy controls are not tested in real homes
next_test: Run a real two-week bounded pilot with predeclared privacy-rejection and retained-use thresholds
